image_model: ideal pinhole with factory K, no distortion; not SDK stereo rectification
synchronization: RGB, Z, instance pass, geometry in one game-thread callback; no world tick between passes

coordinate_axes.camera_optical_m: X right, Y down, Z forward
coordinate_axes.vehicle_flu_m: X forward, Y left, Z up

position_reference: cone mesh world AABB bottom centre (upright cones)
visibility: at least 1 raster pixel in depth-tested instance pass, warped with the same lens map as RGB
bbox_convention: visible pixels only; xyxy right/bottom exclusive; can be clipped/partially occluded

cones.base_reference: world AABB bottom centre; upright cone mesh geometry
